global_vibe: A warm, tactile, Studio Ghibli meets Animal Crossing aesthetic. Not a generic flat tech app. The UI should feel like physical, chunky wooden or clay toys placed on a magical paper-textured world.

layout_and_surfaces.general_spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers. Avoid cramped text.
layout_and_surfaces.surface_style: Neumorphic 'Clay' - solid bright backgrounds, rounded-3xl, with a hard 1px inner border and a pronounced drop shadow (e.g., shadow-[0_4px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]) to simulate a chunky physical toy button.
layout_and_surfaces.hud_style: Floating solid pills with blurred backdrops (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with 1px white border, keeping the focus on the character.

components_strategy.mic_button: Massive, screen-centered or prominently docked at bottom. Needs a 'pulsing' animation state when listening. Use primary color #FF7A59.
components_strategy.progress_bar: Chunky height (h-6), fully rounded, soft mint green filling with a subtle shine effect inside.
components_strategy.speech_bubbles: Should appear dynamically above the character. rounded-2xl with a small tail pointing down. bg-white text-text_main shadow-lg p-4 font-bold text-lg.
components_strategy.cards: For Profile and Lessons: bg-white rounded-3xl border-2 border-border p-6 shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all.

motion_and_interaction.philosophy: Everything should feel elastic and alive. Buttons squish when pressed, menus slide in with a bounce.
motion_and_interaction.character_animations: Use CSS floating/bobbing animation on the character image for idle state. Swap images instantly on state change (talking, confused, happy).

images.description: Character thinking or when it doesn't understand a word

onboarding.layout: Centered character presentation. 'Hello, I'm new here!' sequence.
onboarding.elements: Input form (Profile creation: Name, Age, Hobbies). Use Shadcn customized Inputs (chunky, rounded-xl, text-lg).

home_pet_screen.layout: Full-screen absolute background image (`magical_forest_bg`). Top: HUD (Vocabulary progress bar, Settings icon). Middle: Character dynamically floating, with speech bubbles for interaction. Bottom: Massive Mic CTA, flanked by 'Lessons' and 'Profile' buttons.
home_pet_screen.mechanics: Vocabulary progress bar fills as user speaks to it. Character swaps images based on state (neutral -> listening -> confused -> happy).

lessons_screen.layout: Grid of chunky cards (Math, English, Animals). Clean solid background (`background_base`) to reduce distraction during learning.

profile_screen.layout: Simple read-only list of user's stats (Age, Hobbies) so the character 'remembers' them, rendered as chunky clay-style cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Import and apply 'Nunito' for headings and 'Quicksand' for body text via Google Fonts.

CRITICAL: Implement Shadcn components but override their styles heavily to match the chunky 'Clay' toy aesthetic (rounded-3xl, thick borders, pronounced shadows). Avoid the default sterile Vercel look.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="mic-button"`, `data-testid="lesson-card"`).

Since this is an Expo mobile app concept mapped to a React web stack, ensure the main layout container is strictly mobile-first (e.g. `max-w-md mx-auto h-screen relative overflow-hidden bg-background_base shadow-2xl rounded-[3rem] border-[8px] border-white`) to simulate a phone screen on desktop.
Use the provided image URLs exclusively for the character and background. Map them to states in a React component (e.g., `characterState === 'happy' ? urls[2] : urls[0]`).
Do not use generic FontAwesome icons. Use `lucide-react` with high stroke-width (e.g., strokeWidth={2.5}) to look friendly and tactile.
Use framer-motion or simple CSS keyframes to add a constant gentle vertical 'breathe/bob' animation to the character image.
